items.item:
7. A change whose transaction fails writes no entry and leaves the audit
   sequence as it was; the next accepted change takes the number after it.
   Shows A15-1. [witness: verification:registry_a15_failed_change_leaves_sequence_unchanged]
statements: for entries e1 written before e2: e1.sequence < e2.sequence   -- A15-1

verdicts.item:
7. A change whose transaction fails writes no entry and leaves the audit
   sequence as it was; the next accepted change takes the number after it.
   Shows A15-1. [witness: verification:registry_a15_failed_change_leaves_sequence_unchanged]
statements: for entries e1 written before e2: e1.sequence < e2.sequence   -- A15-1
verdicts.why: The check detects that the failed transaction writes no audit entry and does not advance the stored sequence, then verifies that the next accepted entry follows the prior last sequence by exactly one.
